messages:
maria: quick follow-up from the 2026-03-10 postmortem (missing spans + rollup drift). we need owners and short timelines so these fixes close this sprint. postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-10-spans-agg
ella: ack. i'll own the backfill orchestration and safety limits. plan: dry-run on a read-only snapshot, throttle to 72h windows per job, include --dry-run flag. ETA dry-run 2d, phased backfill 9d.
kevin: i'll take the aggregator join-key fix (nulls causing partial matches). i'll open a migration to default safe service_id and a PR for the corrected join logic + unit tests. ETA 7d for PR + staged rollout.
ajay: i'll add a lightweight CI regression that compares rollup totals to raw spans for a synthetic dataset. blocks merges if deviation >10%. ETA 3d.
sam: ops suggestion: add a recurring coverage sweep every 6 hours. cron: `0 */6 * * *`. write coverage deltas to observability and alert if drop >15% vs 24h baseline.
ops-bot: note: similar span-loss incidents recorded 2025-10-12 and 2026-01-05. recurring pattern flagged; quarterly audit recommended.
maria: owners summary: kevin=aggregator fix (7d), ella=backfill (2d dry-run / 9d phased), ajay=CI test (3d), sam=ops job+alert (1d), maria=postmortem + remediation tracker (1d). confirm?
kevin: confirmed. i'll include before/after metrics and a rollback gate in the PR.
ella: confirmed. backfill job name: `infra.spans.backfill.v3`, implement throttling and retries. i'll also add a dry-run report mode that outputs affected service/time ranges.
ajay: confirmed. i'll push the CI pipeline change and the synthetic test dataset.
sam: ops note: post-deploy smoke should assert top-10 services' rollup_count >= 85% expected over last 1h; if below, trigger rollback and page oncall.
maria: i'll add a calendar event "aggregator-assumptions-audit" with quarterly cadence and own the checklist. i'll update the postmortem with owners/times and add the SQL snippets for runbook.
kevin: i'll tag @maria on the PR when staging looks good and request rollout approval.
maria: final: i'll create remediation tickets, mark P1, and start weekly check-ins until closed. ping this thread for blockers. :thumbsup:
